changed_files.change: PostgreSQL-only UTC month-edge and currency-safety probes use correlated timestamp ranges; SQLite query shape is retained.
PostgreSQL filtered fact reports materialize the scoped applied-build set once; PostgreSQL month summaries use the indexed edge source.
Add PostgreSQL plan bounds and a legacy-query negative control; preserve source parity/oracle checks.

root_causes: The PostgreSQL monthly currency-safety edge query and report edge query did not drive bounded coverage_start probes; on the C12 one_year fixture the safety query visited 440019 of 440032 published contributions and the range materialization plan accumulated about 478725 contribution scan visits.
The PostgreSQL subject-first deleted-task source rescanned usage_projection_applied for each selected fact; C12 EXPLAIN showed 50000 applied-table scan loops.
fix: For PostgreSQL month-edge sources, correlate UTC calendar edge rows with coverage_start ranges through LATERAL probes, retaining published-build joins and all report dimensions.
For filtered PostgreSQL fact reports, materialize the selected scope/generation applied-build set once and join it to subject-first facts.
Keep SQLite source SQL unchanged and retain the existing deadlines and benchmark scenarios.
semantics_coverage: PostgreSQL source parity against fallback source and fixture oracle.
Monthly currency normalization, provider filtering/options, UTC boundary and coarse-coverage fallback, and deleted task/session subjects.
PostgreSQL calendar/pagination, amount boundaries and overflow, source ownership/undated coverage, and int64 provider summary.
